Messages.Author: BenPeal
Messages.Body:
It's with much sadness that I inform you all of the passing of one of the V:TES community's own. Stephen Coombs recently passed away after a tenaciously-fought, lifelong battle with COPD (cardio obstructive pulmonary disease). In the global V:TES community, he's best known for having his portrait on Egothha - his reward for winning a tournament at Dragon*Con. Locally in the US, he was a regular in the Charlotte, NC group. Personally, I'll remember him as a great guy and a worthy opponent. Farewell, Steve.

Steve's winning deck:

thelasombra.com/decks/twd.htm#scoombs
